summary: CoinsPage.tsx and CoinBalance.tsx are rewritten on the Pulse kit against coins-1 / -2 / -3; everything above the returns is kept (hooks, the purchase single-flight, the key minting, the delta timer). Composition as the frames' body scripts: Screen top=push > ScreenHeader push (‹ PROFIL, ÉRMÉK) > the balance stage (StatBlock eyebrow + giant Numeral roll + the 188 coin Pic pinned 20 past the right gutter) > Segmented layout=cells > the view: store = SectionHeader + RowStack close of ListRows (owned: lime check + Megvan; price: TextLink text=data with the coin lead, or the small pill when affordable), achievements = counter + RowStack close of ListRows with the medal Pic (lit / idle 45 %) in a 48 slot and the lock, + the footnote; statement = RowStack of ListRows with the mono signed amount (credit lit, debit ink). Q2 display filter applied. Budget emptied and deleted (51 -> 0). Gap lanes used: TextLink text=data + image lead (G-shell), RowStack close, ListRowSkeleton.
